objects.text:
Phone is ringing...

While waiting for Cesare to answer your call, you remember that he was struggeling with his mental health.

dialogue.content: Hi! What's up!
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: Hi!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Do you have finished the characters already by any chance?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Well, honestly I am struggling a little bit with them, but I think I can have them done by tomorrow!
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: Okay, I will contact you back then around that time!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Bye!
dialogue.name: Cesare

objects.text:
Phone is ringing...

Cesare was vague about what he was struggling with. He promised to provide new material this day.

dialogue.content: [ Groans a little ] He.. Hello [Name]!
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: That does not sound good...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Hi, how's everything going?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Well to be honest...
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: Remember that I told about the psychologist?
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: Uh-huh...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Okay good... So I am afraid I have some relapse happening right now.
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: And... I am afraid that I won't be able to finish the characters.
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: Oof, okay. I am sorry to hear that. No worries. I will take over that task!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Okay, thanks!.
dialogue.name: Cesare

dialogue.content: Hopefully you're feeling better soon! But take your time!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Thanks! Bye.
dialogue.name: Cesare

objects.text:
Phone is ringing...

Julian takes his time to answer the call. You hope he has the ideas for the events ready.

dialogue.content: Hopefully his drunkass mind has seen some sense since last time.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Yoo man! How are you doing!
dialogue.name: Julian

dialogue.content: Hi! Busy as always!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Do you by any chance have already had a look at the events?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Well you know, I first started by doing some reading. Listened to Lisa for once.
dialogue.name: Julian

dialogue.content: So...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I have some rough sketches, but I will finilize them this afternoon. I understand that they're important for the group project.
dialogue.name: Julian

dialogue.content: Okay, I will call you back tomorrow if I don't have them by then, if that's okay.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Yeah sure! See ya.
dialogue.name: Julian

dialogue.content: Really [Name]?! First you patronise me in the group, and now you can't wait for me to send some stuff.
dialogue.name: Julian

dialogue.content: Which means that you haven't done anything yet?
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: As YOU said, I first started by doing some reading. But I think I will have them done by tomorrow.
dialogue.name: Julian

dialogue.content: Okay, I will call you back tomorrow if I don't have them by then, if that's okay.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Still not that patient, are you?! But sure. See ya.
dialogue.name: Julian

objects.text:
Phone is ringing...

Julian again takes his time to answer the call.

dialogue.content: I hope that he has something done. Time is going way too quickly.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: He does not answer his phone.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I better contact Lisa about both the characters and Julian's behaviour.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I better contact Cesare first about the characters. Afterwards I should contact Lisa.
dialogue.name: You

objects.text:
Videocall with Lisa

You've updated Lisa about your progression and the problems you encountered.

dialogue.content: So effectively we're missing two group members now...
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: And two quite big tasks left to be done.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Ow man this sucks so hard. I mean Cesare can't do anything about it, but Julian!
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: So what are we going to do about this?
dialogue.name: Lisa

objects.text:
Videocall with Lisa

You've updated Lisa about your progression and the problems you encountered.

dialogue.content: Yeah that's probably the best...
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: I will write most of the events and also write a report about it.
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: That would be great!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Maybe you can write one or two events too, and the left over characters?
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: I will see what I can do...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I will try to setup a videocall with our teacher later today. I will call your as soon as we are ready.
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: If anything goes wrong, we should probably notify our teacher about the problems.
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: Yeah sure!
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: I think we're set for now! See ya later.
dialogue.name: Lisa

objects.text:
Videocall with Lisa and your Teacher

Your teacher has been updated about the situation. Hopefully he will be able to help.

dialogue.content: Sorry, that I am later. I had still some other stuff to do.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: Haha, that's okay. I've already outlined the situation. So...
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: Sorry, that I am later. I had still some other stuff to do.
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: Haha, that's okay. I've already outlined the situation. So...
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: It's a nasty situation to encounter. I feel sorry for that.
dialogue.name: Teacher

dialogue.content: We can do multiple things.
dialogue.name: Teacher

dialogue.content: I can give you both some extra time, and drop the one-try rule for this course.
dialogue.name: Teacher

dialogue.content: The latter means that in a worst case scenario, you at least can redo this course.
dialogue.name: Teacher

dialogue.content: Okay, yeah that would alleviate at least some pressure in the long term.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: That would help indeed!
dialogue.name: Lisa

dialogue.content: Okay, best of luck with everything! Bye.
dialogue.name: Teacher

dialogue.content: Thank you! Bye.
dialogue.name: Lisa

objects.text:
The last week.

Julia surprises you in the library at school.

dialogue.content: [ Hugs you from behind while you sit on your chair ]
dialogue.name: Julia

dialogue.content: Surprise! Surprise! How's everything going?
dialogue.name: Julia

dialogue.content: Much of the same, I hope we can finish it all.
dialogue.name: You

dialogue.content: You surely will! I believe in you!
dialogue.name: Julia

dialogue.content: So the real estate agent called today and proposed that we come to have look at the appartment this week.
dialogue.name: Julia

dialogue.content: Can you free some time for that?
dialogue.name: Julia

dialogue.content: You had a job interview this week, isn't it?
dialogue.name: Julia

dialogue.content: Do you have still time for that?
dialogue.name: Julia

answer_options.content: [ Do not go to the interview ]

dialogue.content: You had the application for your next degree planned this week right?
dialogue.name: Julia

dialogue.content: Do you have still time for that?
dialogue.name: Julia

answer_options.content: [ Do not apply for your next degree ]
